_comment_webauthn: RelyingPartyId is the parent domain so a passkey works on every subdomain (like the SSO cookie). Origins is the exact allowlist of browser origins that run the passkey ceremonies (the login/security pages) — never a wildcard. Dev values are in appsettings.Development.json.
_comment: Jwt:SigningKey, Encryption:DataKey and Seed:AdminPassword are secrets. Provide them via user-secrets or environment variables (Jwt__SigningKey, Encryption__DataKey, Seed__AdminPassword) — never commit them.
_comment_config_source: The NON-SECRET Jwt issuer/audience plus Sso/WebAuthn/Seed values below are seed defaults + fallback only. At runtime they are sourced from the Mongo 'config' doc (_id app-config), loaded at startup by AppConfigLoader. Token lifetime values are managed on the Settings page and stored in the Mongo 'settings' doc. Secrets above always come from env.
_comment_publicconfig: Non-secret, shareable app config served at GET /api/config so sibling apps don't duplicate it. Seeds the DB on first run only; edit thereafter on the admin Settings screen.
_comment_storage: File storage. Provider/bucket/R2 credentials are managed at runtime on the admin Settings screen (stored in Mongo; the S3 secret key is AES-encrypted with Encryption:DataKey). These values are only the first-run seed + the local-disk root; the S3 secret is NEVER read from or written to this file.
_comment_websites: Seeds the website registry (admin -> Settings -> Website registry) with any of the family's sites that aren't in it yet. Only used for rows that don't exist; edits made in the UI are never overwritten. The key 'portfolio' is what keshavsingh.in reports page views under.
_comment_dbconsole: The Admin-only database console (Manage -> Database). AllowWrites turns on single-document insert/update/delete; reads are always allowed. Aggregations are read-only whatever this says ($out/$merge are refused), as is server-side JavaScript. RedactedFields ADDS to the package's built-in list of secret field names, which are replaced with a placeholder in every result. Set AllowWrites to false to make the console read-only.

MongoConsole._comment_redacted: This app's own secret-bearing fields, by their exact stored names. PasswordHash and TokenHash are already covered by the package's built-in list; these are the ones only this app has. Matching is exact and case-insensitive on purpose — a substring rule would redact SiteKey/WebsiteKey/ContentKey, which are not secrets.

_comment_calls: Group audio/video calls (WebRTC). Calls are a peer-to-peer mesh with no media server, so MaxParticipants is a real limit: every extra person costs each participant another upstream. Only STUN is listed here: it is public and unauthenticated. A TURN relay is needed for peers behind symmetric NAT — set Calls__Turn__Urls__0 plus Calls__Turn__Username / Calls__Turn__Credential (or Calls__Turn__UseEphemeralCredentials=true with Calls__Turn__StaticAuthSecret) as environment variables. TURN credentials are secrets and must NEVER be committed here.
_comment_meetings: Scheduled meetings. Reminders are pushed over the chat hub, so a signed-in browser gets them wherever it is in the app.
